method: Untimed. The counting diff (census-main.patch on main ddf753a5, census-head.patch on the branch) is applied to esp-periph/src/timg.rs and both trees are built with `cargo +1.99.0 build --release -p esp32sim --bin esp32sim --bin esp32sim-c3`. Counters are process-wide over every Timer::step call: step_calls, enabled (TIMG_T0_EN set), below_divisor (accumulator below the divisor after the add), divisions (executions of the prescaler division line). Printed once per dropped TimerGroup; the largest (final) line is kept. Wall times are omitted from the stop lines.
